purpose: Bound the blast radius of the D1/D2/A2 repair. A failing suite in this repo is mostly a missing-optional-dependency environment gap, so the honest claim is a SET COMPARISON against the untouched producer snapshot, not a count comparison: identical failing/erroring test IDs before and after.

baseline.what: pristine producer snapshot 6c56332c in a separate git worktree (/tmp/opencode/lex_root_b), unmodified
baseline.why: the repair is the only difference between the two trees, so any status change is attributable to it

method.ignore_rationale: 18 modules cannot be COLLECTED without sentence_transformers (a missing optional dep), so they are excluded from BOTH runs identically. This exclusion is disclosed, not silent.
method.comparison: diff of the sorted FAILED/ERROR test-ID sets (both differences, not the two counts)

results.note: Counts are over UNIQUE test IDs (sort -u); the raw run emits some IDs under both FAILED and ERROR, so a raw line count exceeds the unique ID count. The comparison is a SET comparison (both differences + intersection), never a matching-count argument. Result: repaired-only difference is EMPTY (no new failures) and the baseline-only difference holds exactly one ID - the state-contract CLI check that was red on the pristine snapshot and is green after this cycle.
results.passed_count_note: Re-measured directly: '46 failed, 525 passed, 2 skipped, 30 errors'. Pristine was '47 failed, 519 passed, 2 skipped, 30 errors'. The +6 delta is 5 new tests from this repair plus the one repaired state-contract test.

verdict: NO_REGRESSION, AND ONE PRE-EXISTING FAILURE REPAIRED. The repaired-only failing set is EMPTY, so this cycle introduced nothing. The baseline-only set holds exactly one ID: product/tests/test_state_contract.py::test_cli_returns_zero_when_the_contract_holds, which was red on the pristine snapshot and is green now (the state-contract direction pin tracked v52 while the dispatched control plane is v55). All remaining 76 IDs are pre-existing environment gaps in this container - overwhelmingly ModuleNotFoundError: sentence_transformers - NOT caused by this repair and NOT claimed fixed.

repaired_module.was: 17 passed on the producer snapshot (before the D1/D2/A2 repair)

environment_note: 18 further modules remain UNCOLLECTED here for want of sentence_transformers. Their status this cycle is UNMEASURED, not passed and not failed. A runner with that dep installed must collect them; this artifact does not certify them.

state_contract_repair.finding: test_state_contract.py pinned RUN_DIRECTION_VERSION=52 (run 39034350468's dispatch) while this cycle is dispatched against the v55 control plane, leaving the canonical-state contract red.
state_contract_repair.fix: Re-pinned RUN_DIRECTION_VERSION to 55 and set state/product.json direction_version to the integer 55, following the file's own documented per-dispatch pattern.
state_contract_repair.not_weakened: No assertion was removed or loosened; only the dispatch reference moved.
